reviews.title: I can use these anywhere
reviews.comment:
Best purchase I've made for remote work. I can be in the middle of a noisy coffee shop or brewery with loud music, and can still hear my calls clearly, and my audience can hear me too with the mouthpiece. Great for the noisy office too. I love both the active noise cancelling and the pass-through option if I'm in a quiet area and need to ensure I'm not yelling.
I use the wired option so I don't have to worry about charging them, and I have a USB converter so I can use it with my Macbook.
My suggestions would be: have a USB-C option if that's a thing, and make these with bigger ear pads. They do hurt a bit after several hours of work.
reviews.author: Bklassynow

reviews.title: I bought this because the ANC feature actually works!!!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1eYABNcbuL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/419llFZkRGL._SY256.jpg I recently bought the Impact 860 headset, and I absolutely love it! One of my favorite features is the sturdy headband—it’s made of plastic rather than rubber, so it doesn’t strip like my previous headset. Another great feature is the mic’s auto-mute function. If you lift the mic from your mouth to your ear, it automatically mutes, which is super convenient.
But the standout feature for me is the active noise cancelling. As a stay-at-home mom who works from home, this is a game-changer. It effectively blocks out background noise, whether it’s my baby, neighborhood dogs, or the garbage truck honking outside. With my old headset, I constantly worried about noise interference, which gave me anxiety, especially when I had to manage my child or deal with unexpected loud sounds.
This headset has made my work life so much more comfortable and stress-free. I can even move around and know that background noise won’t be picked up during calls. It’s a significant investment, but completely worth it if you’re looking for reliable noise cancellation. Trust me—this headset delivers on its promise.
If you need a quality noise-cancelling headset, the Impact 860 is worth every penny. Invest in yourself and get one!
reviews.author: Iesha

reviews.title: Distorted screeching sounds
reviews.comment: Worked for 4 months then started having terrible screeching and distorted noise. Noise cancelling microphone also stopped working. I work from home with small children and got in trouble. This is too expensive to not be working after such a short time
reviews.author: Lee

reviews.title: Worth the price
reviews.comment: Worth the investment. I wfh and my kids cannot be heard. Even when my 3 year old screams. They have been a complete lifesaver! Also very comfortable and very little voice distortion when any. Fit is perfect and could easily adjust if needed.
reviews.author: A.C.

reviews.title: Doesn’t always work
reviews.comment: The noise cancellation feature is awesome.  I work from home and worry they will hear the dog bark or something which will get me fired. So I got this hoping for a cure for background noise. It works great at that, if only it would work with avaya all the time. It will just stay muted so the callers cannot hear me at all. It’s something in my settings that changes when I log off. I think the headset is great, but there seems to be a glitch with my avaya working with it in windows 11. After I mess with it and get the kinks worked out I am super happy that the customers cannot hear my dog bark etc.
reviews.author: christina kelley
